events.evidence: The United States House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence holds a hearing about Russian interference in the 2016 election
British Prime Minister Theresa May announces that her government will trigger article 50, which begins the process of withdrawing from the European Union, on March 29
A car bomb in Baghdad's southwestern Hayy Al-A'amel neighborhood kills at least 23 people

label.note: Brexit trigger and Russia probe intensify uncertainty; Baghdad bombing adverse.
